title: Unconditional Gaussian Symplectic Maintenance Bounds, Exact Pythagorean Defects, and Cristae-Collar Conditional Mutual Information Decay Closing the Biology-Grade E-Track
abstract: Our prior resource-boundary audit (ARR-2026-1E91AXEJYT890TQC) left open the biology-grade E-track: whether metabolically driven mitochondrial cristae could sustain non-equilibrium Gaussian squeezing, continuous-variable entanglement, or long-range conditional mutual information (CMI) at 310 K in the 71-THz mito-polariton regime of the unrefereed preprint bioRxiv:10.64898/2026.09.10.750628v1 (awaiting independent replication). Backed by MITO-GAUSSIAN-SYMPLECTIC-CMI-CERT-1.0 (20 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems, 0 sorry, 0 grind, 0 Classical.choice; AST-audited zero-float verifier; 16 SHA-256 certificates C01-C16; 57 adversarial tests), we close the Gaussian E-track unconditionally: (i) the single-mode Pythagorean quadrature defect (a+b)^2 = 4(ab-c^2) + (a-b)^2 + 4c^2 forces strict excess energy whenever a mode is squeezed or correlated; (ii) exact two-mode Robertson-Schrodinger and PPT polynomial factorizations yield an unconditional entanglement-energy floor Delta n_ent >= (1 - 2 nu_PT)^2 / (8 nu_PT) tightly saturated by pure TMSV (C05); (iii) in any linear thermal-bath parametric cavity (NOPA) at T > 0, stability imposes a universal sub-1-ebit ceiling E_N < 1 (C08), forbids steady entanglement for hot modes (nu_th >= 1, C11), and forces P_maint = 9.75 nW (>974x basal 10 pW mito power) for 0.5 ebit at 71 THz, gamma=1 THz (C09) and 107.5 pW (>10.7x) even for 0.2 ebit at Q=710 (C10); (iv) unpumped 71-THz entanglement suffers sudden death in 9.60-9.85 ps (C12); and (v) coupled cristae-collar Gaussian precision networks exhibit exact Markovian I(A:C|B)=0 with geometric marginal decay (<8e-6 nats at d=4, C13) and exponential CMI decay under evanescent bypass (<10^-6 nats, C14-C15).
